changes.title: Treehouse rooms
items: The treehouse has rooms: walk from the hub along its corridors to the dressing room, bedroom, garage, studio, kitchen, tea room, card room, bestiary and crow's nest
Change your look at the mirror, wardrobe, cloak pegs, shoe rack and bags, and your broom at the broom stand; your hats lie on the dressing room floor to pick up and put down
Hold E at the bed to sleep and end the night
The bestiary's book opens the zoo over the night
The Bedroom button and F are gone: the treehouse's stations are the way back to your room

changes.title: Landing trees
items: Sailing back to an island you've visited draws its trees at once; tonight's own trees are drawn while you choose and sail, and take their place before you see the island
The sea chart starts drawing your likely next island's trees as soon as it opens

changes.title: Chart freeze
items: The night pauses while the sea chart is open (the music too), so the chart and the next island's trees get the computer's full attention
?timing=1 puts how long each step of sailing takes into the playtest log (L)
